name: Werl (Germany)
description: White hoist charged with the city arms of Werl (a black cross with a key on white) beneath the inscription STADT WERL in black, the fly divided horizontally black over white.
history: Municipal flag of Werl; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: white hoist, the fly divided black over white
